instruction: Buy me a hedge trimmer on amazon under $60 (excluding tax), over 3.9 rating, and over 5 reviews, and have it delivered to home address.
notes: Single-app purchase task. search_products (no token needed) is called with product_type/max_price/min_product_rating filters and yields a candidate; show_product verifies the strict criteria (price < 60, rating > 3.9, reviews > 5) since the API filters are inclusive and do not cover review count. The cart is cleared before adding the product so the new order contains exactly one item with quantity 1 (default quantity). Home address and payment card ids are discovered via show_addresses / show_payment_cards; no address or card is modified. place_order with the Home address id produces the order; complete_task takes no answer. Supervisor and amazon declared as app constants; supervisor.show_addresses could optionally be used to confirm the Home address details.

plan: (amazon-add-address home-address-name home-address-street home-address-city home-address-state home-address-country home-address-zip amazon-token home-address)
